newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 13.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 13.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Radio Latvia's Friday noon news. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament chairman Alfreds Chepanis and President Guntis Ulmanis met to discuss the current political situation. Ulmanis considers it stable enough to leave for a two-week holiday.
- Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs meets U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Aulbright in Washington. He is the last Baltic foreign minister to visit Washingtom before the Madrid NATO summit.
- Three Russian-language newspapers launced an appeal for donations to restore the bombed Victory monument.
- A fisherman in Jekabpils caught a 30 kg cat fish, 1.75 metres long. Big, but still way off the all-time record of a 56 kg catfish in Latvia.
